localizedValues.description: This site on the Cascadia Marine Trail is available first come first served to campers who arrive by wind/human powered beachable watercraft.

localizedValues.name: HB1

localizedValues.name: Lowell Point Kitchen Shelter
localizedValues.description: Day use area rentals can be reserved by calling 360-387-1550.

localizedValues.name: Amphitheater
localizedValues.description:
Day use area rentals can be reserved by calling 360-387-1550.
The amphitheater is located on a rustic hillside setting. It comes with a wooden projection screen and has tree-slab benches on either side of an aisle. The highest level of the Amphitheater is ADA Accessible. There is no exclusive parking for this location. Carpooling is recommended.

localizedValues.name: North Beach Meadow
localizedValues.description:
Day use area rentals can be reserved by calling 360-387-1550.
Large multi-level lawn area along bluff edge with slight 15 feet elevation change to a more secluded space often used for ceremonies. The lower picnic space level is ADA accessible. The North Beach Meadow includes seven picnic tables and one regular sized barbecue on the lower level and eight picnic tables and two large barbecues on the upper level.

localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description: There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
